module.title: GNSS single-point positioning
module.expensive_path: Repeated satellite state and correction evaluation followed by iterative weighted least-squares position/clock estimation for each observation epoch; Doppler velocity estimation when available. Current official examples are short, so no acceleration claim is established.
module.rationale: User-selected narrow scope: the contributor explicitly said 先选SPP (select SPP first). RTKLIB remains the codebase identity and the entire pinned upstream tree is vendored. This is a documented exception to the whole-codebase default, not a claim that the sibling positioning algorithms use different physics. The proposed task will exercise the SPP scientific path through the unmodified RNX2RTKP single-point mode and its shared dependencies; curator acceptance remains pending.
excluded: CONVBIN, RTKRCV, STR2STR, GUI programs and miscellaneous utility applications
Bundled third-party libraries, documentation and legacy IDE/build artifacts
hazards: Eight explicitly single-point application targets primarily reuse one input dataset and vary serialization; they are not eight independent scientific scenarios.
An official time unit test contains an obsolete future leap-second expectation; stock all-unit compilation also has missing sources/linkage. These failures are retained in the native record.
RNX2RTKP can exit zero without producing a position: output presence and content require independent checking.
Native same-host repeatability is not an independent absolute-position validation. Coverage of Doppler velocity, multi-constellation data, fault detection and clock bias remains to be established.
No Docker run, scientific tolerance, nominal/variant calibration or task reward has been established.
